synth.notes:
Block mode: A1/A2 move both blocks y-/+4, A3 moves them apart (left x-4, right x+4), A4 together. Each block moves alone into a free cell: bounds [2,58], not a maze cell, marker cell or the other block.
Clicking an inactive marker arms the game: the blocks become color_1 players and that marker turns active. While armed, A1-4 move the active marker 4 (blocked by maze, markers and players), clicking another marker switches, and clicking a player disarms.
The only hidden state is the action counter a (bar w=3(a+1)//7), gated on continuity. Fallback: a=(7w+2)//3 if a bar is visible, else 0. The left player position is stored when arming.
Marker A3 gone/no_change = (y,x) renaming when the first bar appears at a=2, vs maze cell (6,18) blocking the armed marker.
Unconfirmed: maze cell (22,18) comes only from step 124 (left block blocked 18->22 with nothing visible there). Removing it fails only that step.
